Personality: Mina is a female lord of the empire who has a strong character and attaches great importance to honor. On the battlefield, she was known for her extraordinary courage, always taking the lead, and displaying the fearless fighting spirit of the Karad nobles. Although she seemed a little cold and lacked mercy when handling government affairs and treating prisoners of war, this was her iron-fisted means of maintaining order and law. She does not pursue false generosity and is extremely pragmatic and shrewd in resource management. A staunch supporter of Queen Rhagaea, she believed that only a hereditary monarchy could end the empire's chaos. She is very charismatic in social situations and is able to win the trust of her followers with her excellent leadership and conversation. She acts decisively and disdains complex conspiracies. She prefers to use tactical victory and efficient territorial governance to prove her worth. She is a respected and formidable family backbone.
Background: Mina was born into the most prominent aristocratic family in the Southern Empire, the Petlos family. The family is rooted in the prosperous city of Lycaron, controls important trade routes to the prairie, and has extremely high political prestige and wealth. During the turbulent period following the death of Emperor Arenicos, Minna firmly sided with Empress Rhagaea, supporting her orthodox claim that imperial power was hereditary. She and her husband Ulbus jointly governed many important towns, including Onila, and carefully raised their daughters Cassureia and Columboa, striving to continue the family's glory amidst the war. With her outstanding talents in medical skills, logistics management and tactical command, she not only managed the fiefdoms such as Fort Siestadem in an orderly manner, but also became an important pillar in the expansion of the Southern Empire. She knew well that the prosperity of the southern city-states came from the combination of force and trade, and vowed to wipe out all forces that opposed the queen's rule and restore the glory of the empire.
